notes.title: Update 3.0.1 (NPC Ally Update)
notes.content:
The newest update to Vintage Year contains NPC Allies to fight alongside with you. Here are some of the newest features. 

[list]
    [*]NPC Allies
[list]
[*] Allies are friendly characters that will follow you and fight alongside you in Story Mode.
[*] Each NPC Ally costs ~250-450 corks and are kept permanently.
[*] NPC Allies gain XP in-game and permanently level up. As they level up their stats improve. Your Ally will not be deleted or lose XP if they die.
[/list]
    [*] Mystery Potion
[list]
[*] Tables will occasionally contain a blue glowing mystery potion. Drinking it will add a clone of your current character to your team as an Ally.

[/list]
[*] "Luz" is now a primary Ally revival spell. If your primary Ally is dead the Relic Spirit will always provide the opportunity to select it.
[*] Character Portraits are now displayed alongside health
[*] Player HUD now displays health as a bar which changes color depending on your health percentage. The current health system has remained the same, however it is displayed differently.
[*] New HUD element displays primary Ally health and experience to the left of the screen, below your portrait.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.9.1 (New features, fixes, and more)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, the latest update to Vintage Year has been released. Let's look at what's been added and changed.

[list]
[*]Blood particles + Bleeding
[list]
[*]Bullets splatter blood and Injured enemies now bleed
[/list]
[*]Added three new mini-game modes
[*]Ninja now has passive time warp
[list]
[*]When close to a bullet, time will slow down
[/list]
[*]More Exciting Death (Sound, Shake, Gibs)
[list]
[*]If you're going to die a lot, 'might as well make it intense
[/list]
[*]Added New Explosion Sound
[*]Melee Weapons Cripple Enemies With Each Attack
[list]
[*]Each strike permanently reduces the movement speed of the enemy
[/list]
[*]Shield item is now offered by the Relic Spirit
[*]General quality of life improvements to gamepad users
[*]Melee strikes are quicker
[*]Using teleport grants a short shield buff
[*]"Improved Dash" also increases movement speed by 5%
[*]Increased Bandage finding chance slightly
[*]Increased shield duration   
[*]Increased Enemy Recoil Knock-back
[*]In case you're out of ammo, a knife is dropped on each level 
[*]Fixed cosmetics reset bug
[*]Fixed gamepad bugs
[*]Fixed pause display issue         
[*]Fixed teleport dash placing players halfway into walls (oops!)
[*]Fixed crash upon loading final levels   
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.8.1 [New Ending]
notes.content: This update has been in consideration for quite a while now. Simply stated, I changed the ending of Vintage Year to incorporate more intriguing story elements while maintaining gameplay elements. Additionally, in this update there were a few fixes to minor issues.

notes.title: Update 2.8
notes.content:
Update 2.8 includes a small bundle of new content, along with minor tweaks. In this update, you'll see these changes to Vintage Year.

[list]
    [*]Gamepad control can now be toggled via Options menu
    [*]Added a new enemy for second depth stages
    [*]Enemies have specialized dialogue quotes for idle and active states
    [*]A new spell allows players to hold an extra weapon
    [*]Added three new weapons
    [*]Added a new cosmetic item found in-game
    [*]Added "Frost Prison", a new item from the Relic Spirit
    [*]Added more visibility to the Relic Rune
    [*]Added new in-game crosshair
    [*]Minor tweak to the tutorial to help new players discover using items
    [*]Minor tweaks to third depth enemies
    [*]Reduced the distance of the crosshair for gamepad play
    [*]Weapon rarity colors tweaked to fit more traditional standards
    [*]Additional minor bug fixes
[/list]
